snippet.title: Roco Kingdom - Official Global Announce Trailer  | gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Roco Kingdom is going global! Join the closed beta test on October 27, pre-register, and wishlist now!

Roco Kingdom is a "new evolution of open-world creature-collecting game" where you adventure with you Jinies, attend Magic Academy classes, build your dream home, explore the continent of Carosia, and much more. Oh, and you won't have to do it alone as you can hop into the fun with friends!

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom
